caption: The drawing depicts a single, curved object resembling a whale's tooth, positioned upright and centered on a plain off-white or light beige background. The tooth is primarily a muted yellowish-brown color with subtle shading to suggest its form and texture. Etched or drawn onto the surface of the tooth is an outline of a sailing ship, featuring masts, sails, and rigging, rendered in fine, delicate lines. The bottom of the tooth has a faint shadow to anchor it to the background. Near the bottom right of the tooth, there is a small, neatly printed name: "C. MILLER." The composition is minimal, with the tooth and its illustration occupying only a small area of the canvas, surrounded by ample negative space.
title: Scrimshaw
